question: Is the frozen positive flavonol pooled prediction gain broadly distributed among taxa or concentrated in a few recipients, and does phylogenetic locality overcome the exact random-two-donor variance penalty?
fixed_choices: Same 47 species, 6 original pigment states, all original 21 genes, original 9/4/8 modules, k=2, same class-mean baseline and other-46 training variances.
diagnostics: All 47 recipient paired loss differences, win/loss/tie counts, median difference
All 47 recipient-only omission gains with unchanged predictions; no retraining
Top 1 and top 3 positive contribution leverage and all constituent recipient rows
Exact random-two penalty R-B and locality benefit R-N, with net B-N=(R-N)-(R-B)
